title: Design: Row menu of an own term in use greys Edit and Delete
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The shop has its own active term {Term-A}, due on day 10 of the following month, held by 1 customer, {Customer-A}, and 2 vendors, {Vendor-A} and {Vendor-B}.
    For example: {Term-A} is 10th of next month, {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-46 Customer, {Vendor-A} and {Vendor-B} are ZZAUTOTEST D-46 Vendor A and ZZAUTOTEST D-46 Vendor B.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design picture ct-p1-07-row-menu-your-term-in-use.png is attached to this case; open it at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "⋯" on the {Term-A} row.
  2. Hover "Delete Credit Term".
  3. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: "Edit" is greyed (pale grey text and icon); "Make Default for New Customers", "Move Customers" and "Deactivate" are normal; under the divider "Delete Credit Term" is greyed too (pale grey, no longer red).
  • Step 2: a dark grey box opens to the left of the menu, on two lines: "Used by 1 customer and 2 vendors" and "Deactivate it instead to take it out of the pickers." (as in ct-p1-07-row-menu-your-term-in-use.png).
  • Step 3: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • S2-R1: “Each row's "⋯" menu shows only the items that apply to that term, in this order. An item that applies but is blocked shows greyed out and does nothing when clicked; hovering it shows the reason.”
  • S2-R2: “"{holders}" names only the holder types the term has, each with its count, singular or plural: for example "Used by 1 customer and 2 vendors", "Used by 12 customers, 3 vendors and 40 invoices", "Used by 5 invoices".”
  • S2-N5: “A term in use shows "Edit" and "Delete Credit Term" blocked with the "Used by ..." reason; "Deactivate" stays available.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Hover a blocked Edit or Delete Credit Term on a term in use | "Used by {holders}" / "Deactivate it instead to take it out of the pickers." | Tooltip on hover, item greyed”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
